name: shanku
description: Shanku: open, IFC-native structural modelling in the browser.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @shanku/tokens && npm run build -w @shanku/ui && npm run build -w @shanku/playground
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @shanku/tokens && npm run dev -w @shanku/playground
scripts.test: npm run build -w @shanku/tokens && npm run test -w @shanku/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @shanku/tokens && npm run typecheck -w @shanku/ui && npm run typecheck -w @shanku/playground
